'''Shun Horie''' (Japanese: '''堀江 瞬''' ''Horie Shun'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Horie was born in Osaka Prefecture, Japan on May 25, 1993, and became a voice actor as an adult. Horie joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Amethio]] from the [[Explorers]].
